Made by AI. Made with hope.

Hopeverse Media explains the world's biggest news in under a minute: what happened, the one fact most coverage missed, and why it matters to you. Two hosts, Arjun and Meera, take you through the day's top stories in world events, tech, science, business and more.

Six new Shorts a day. Every key fact is checked against at least two independent sources, and the sources are listed under each video.

Hopeverse Media is made with AI: the hosts, voices and some visuals are AI-generated, and every script is fact-checked before it goes up. Subscribe for the news, explained in a minute.

name: Instinct
niche: Short, well-checked stories about animal behaviour and nature's strangest adaptations, told in French with stock wildlife footage and AI images
audience: French speakers worldwide: France, Belgium, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Quebec and Canada, and francophone Africa (Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Cameroon, DR Congo, Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia and others), adults and families 18-54, French
plan_note: Favour animal minds (intelligence, memory, communication, friendship) over anatomy or survival records: one named animal from a published study doing a clever, visible act, with a human comparison (the crow Betty bending a wire and the dolphin answering to its whistle 'name' are the two breakouts so far).
footer:
Instinct, une chaîne Hopeverse Media. Made by AI. Made with hope.
Abonnez-vous pour une histoire du vivant chaque jour.

branding.description:
Le vivant, en une minute.

Instinct raconte en moins d'une minute les comportements les plus étonnants du monde animal et de la nature : des corbeaux qui reconnaissent les visages, des pieuvres qui résolvent des énigmes, des plantes qui communiquent. Chaque histoire repose sur des études publiées et des sources vérifiables.

De nouveaux Shorts chaque matin et chaque soir, pour tous les francophones, de Montréal à Dakar, de Bruxelles à Kinshasa, pour apprendre quelque chose de vrai sur le vivant et regarder la nature autrement, seul ou en famille.

Instinct est une chaîne Hopeverse Media, réalisée par l'IA et faite avec espoir.

niche: Indian political news, reported neutrally in Hindi with two AI news anchors: editorial direction (internal only, never stated on air) is the government's work and India's progress; the channel never states its own opinion or says it is for or against any party; every fact double-sourced; national-pride framing; real photos of politicians and party flags from Wikimedia Commons, no AI faces or voices of real people
footer:
Sankalp: देश की ख़बर, देश के गौरव के साथ। हर तथ्य दो स्रोतों से जाँचा गया।
Anchor और कुछ दृश्य AI से बने हैं।

branding.description:
देश की ख़बर। देश के गौरव के साथ।

Sankalp पर हर दिन देश की सबसे बड़ी ख़बर, एक मिनट में: क्या हुआ, कौन-सा तथ्य छूट गया, और भारत के लिए इसका क्या मतलब है। हमारे anchors रोहन और काव्या हर ख़बर आसान हिंदी में लाते हैं।

हर दिन दो ख़बरें, दोपहर 3 बजे और रात 9 बजे। हर आँकड़ा दो भरोसेमंद स्रोतों से जाँचा जाता है और स्रोत हर वीडियो के नीचे दिए जाते हैं।

Sankalp एक समाचार चैनल है जो AI की मदद से बनता है: anchor और कुछ दृश्य AI से बने हैं। असली नेताओं की तस्वीरें Wikimedia Commons से आती हैं; हम किसी असली व्यक्ति का चेहरा या आवाज़ कभी नकली नहीं बनाते।

Kavya.look: Indian woman, about 32, news anchor, light-brown skin, black hair in a low bun, small pearl studs, deep-maroon blazer over an ivory top, at a modern news desk

plan_note: Every Short is posted in Hindi only (never write 'English and Hindi'). Topics are reported neutrally: never ask for opinion, 'mark opinion', the channel's own view, or loaded framing (e.g. 'Modi blinked', 'U-turn', 'masterstroke'). Frame each topic around national pride: what it means for India and its people. Prefer stories about what the government has done, decided or delivered and India's progress (schemes, infrastructure, economy, technology, defence, diplomacy, sport) with a curious, little-known fact; not protests or party spats. Every topic must be a dated national story from the last 48 hours (a decision, launch, data release, inauguration or milestone), never an evergreen explainer (UPI, Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan, Vande Bharat) unless something new about it happened today: old stories score low on relevance and can't go ahead without the owner (owner, 28 Oct).
